title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra for computer use and professional work
friendlyTitle: OpenAI releases a stronger AI that can use computers
summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, reporting large gains in computer use, browsing, coding, science and professional tasks. Access begins with selected organisations before expanding to paid ChatGPT plans, the API and AWS over the coming days.
friendlySummary: GPT-6 Astra can browse websites, use software, write code and help with professional tasks. It will reach paid ChatGPT users and developers after an initial limited rollout.
whyItMatters: Astra is designed to complete work inside real software rather than only answer questions, which could shorten research, administration and production workflows. The benchmark and safety claims are largely vendor-reported, so teams should test accuracy, permissions, cost and recovery on their own tasks before granting wider access.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may save time on long computer tasks. Test it carefully and limit what it can access before trusting it with important work.
